meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序编排多步任务,单阶段逐个执行,失败自动重试并续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一批互相依赖的任务,需要按先后顺序自动跑完。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a batch of tasks depend on each other and must run in order.

howto.what: 它把一件大任务拆成有依赖关系的节点图(C 要先等 A、B 完成),按波次并行派子代理执行,每个阶段算一次运行。单个节点失败可以重跑、改指令或发消息救回,已完成的节点结果会复用。
howto.when: 当你提到 mass-ulw、任务 DAG,或要求「部分任务必须先等其他任务完成」的分批并行工作时触发。完全独立的并行任务用不上它。

say.text: 把这次运行 snapshot 一下,看每个节点现在什么状态。
say.note: 读取一次节点状态和数量。

say.text: lint 节点跑偏了,send 消息让它跳过 vendored 目录。

howto.what_en: It splits a job into a dependency-ordered node graph (C waits for A and B) and runs it in parallel waves as child agents, one run per phase. A failed node can be retried, amended or messaged; finished nodes keep cached results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others. Fully independent parallel tasks do not need it.

say_en.text: Build a task DAG with mass-ulw: audit first, rewrite depends on it, then verify.
say_en.note: Defines a three-node graph and starts the run.

say_en.text: Snapshot the run so I can see where each node stands.
say_en.note: Reads node states and counts once.

say_en.text: The lint node drifted - send it a message to skip the vendored dir.
